POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, MARCH 9, 2026
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM
Sarah Bedy, Member  Julie Lie, Member
Doug Killion, Member  Leanna Noble, Member
  Patricia Scott, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Sarah Bedy called the meeting to order at 2:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Lie, Killion, Scott

  Commissioners Absent: Noble

Also present: Joseph Botelho, Community Program Specialist V, Jennifer Santana, Secretary.

Roll call taken by Jennifer Santana.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54441  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Homeless Services
  Policy Subcommittee meeting of Monday, January 12, 2026.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Lie, Killion, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Noble

2.  26-54534  Recommendation to receive and file the discussion concerning a proposal for
  project funding to the Homeless Services Mayor’s Fund Subcommittee.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4 Bedy, Lie, Killion, Scott
  No:  0 None

  Page 1 of 3
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, MARCH 9, 2026
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 1 Noble

  • The subcommittee discussed the Mayor’s Fund proposal. Option 1 focused
  on funding one staffed overnight portable toilet and option 2 is to staff a
  mobile shower truck. Members discussed the overnight hours that these
  proposals would include and hotspot areas that could work as possible
  locations. Members would like staff to review the proposal and provide
  feedback.
  • In addition to the portable toilet, members suggested the possibility of a
  smart public restroom operated by Throne Labs.
  • The members discussed the mobile shower that was approved for purchase
  by council, they discussed funding and location challenges. The
  subcommittee members requested additional information regarding the
  mobile showers.

3.  26-54535  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion of the draft 2025 Homeless
  Services Advisory Committee Annual Report.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Lie, Killion, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Noble

  • The subcommittee reviewed the draft of the 2025 Annual Report and
  discussed the recommendations they would like to highlight this year. Staff
  will make several updates to the Mayor’s Fund award chart. Chair Sarah
  Bedy will draft the recommendations to present at the upcoming Commission
  meeting.

4.  26-54442  Recommendation to discuss and approve future agenda items.

  A motion was made by Voting Member Scott, seconded by Member Killion, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Lie, Killion, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
